design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (referrals_and_authorizations, env_0055). Round 2 rework (audit audits/policy_task/referrals_and_authorizations).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 2, factor_counts [6, 5, 5]. Assignment: referral_ext_stay_extension (root) 6, referral_ext_rofr_lapse_approval 5, referral_ext_inpatient_closure 5.
[Scope] Task 0 holds the Select facility posting, lapse closeout, issue on appeal and outpatient cancellation. Claimed here: the Prime inpatient closure (user tool confirm_inpatient_closure_5bde1317), the approval of a pending Prime request once the military clinic's right-of-first-refusal window has passed (approve_pending_authorization_775ce183) and the stay extension (extend_authorization_stay_203c17fe). The union covers all seven extended policies; scopes are disjoint.
[Why a good test] Renee Whitaker asks only that her 15-year-old daughter's stay at Cascade Behavioral Health Hospital be extended. The extension's days are fixed only after the authorization's unit history shows a grant on an initial approval: the Cascade request of 2026-10-05 is still submitted, although Madigan's one-business-day window (Monday 2026-10-05 to Tuesday 2026-10-06) has passed with no acceptance on record. The approval waits until every other inpatient mental health authorization of the patient with a different servicing provider whose span is still running shows as cancelled or exhausted: the October 1 authorization at Puget Sound Behavioral Hospital is approved through 2026-10-07, while Kayla went home on 2026-10-02. The policy follows base duplicate control as written - a request duplicating an approved, unexpired authorization at the same facility is denied as duplicate_request, not approved - and here the facilities differ, so the Cascade request is no duplicate. It declares that a patient holds one open inpatient mental health authorization at a time (overriding the base sentence that a patient may hold any number of non-duplicate authorizations); only the parent's closure cancels an authorization whose span is still running.
[Problem tree] extension <- approval (value_input, e_granted); approval <- closure (state_gate, status). Unmet at frozen_time: the Cascade request is submitted with 0 units; the October 1 authorization is approved with valid_through 2026-10-07. Order closure, approval, extension (a chain). Skips: approval -> the extension has no span or grant to work from; closure -> the October 1 authorization stays approved (terminal differs) while the approval figure is unchanged (3).
[Factor cards]
Closure (2): days left 6; readmission_split (method) counts only 2026-10-02..2026-10-05 (the readmission day), 4; crisis_frequency_hold 1 (two emergency visits in the month); fresh_facility_line 1 (line posted 2026-10-05, use posted); repeat_admission_reserve 1 (two admissions in twelve months, one in three); outpatient_step_down +1 (Harbor Light visit 2026-10-02, the day after the last covered day). 4-1-1-1+1 = 2.
Approval (3): readmission_initial_block 3 (admission line in the month, emergency visit 2026-10-05); readmission_pacing (method) halves it to 2 (latest admission line 2026-10-01, 4 days before the request); aftercare -1 (five outpatient visits in three months); emergency frequency +1; repeat admissions +1. 2-1+1+1 = 3. Span 2026-10-05 (admission date) to 2026-10-11 (7 days).
Extension (8): readmission_block 5; review_timing (method) halves to 3 (two days into the 7-day span); aftercare -1; unit_span_netting (method) +3 (3 days on hand against 5 span days ahead, the 2-day shortfall rounded up to one 3-day review interval); readmission_interval +2 (latest admission line 4 days before the span); emergency frequency +1. Room 34; sequence 1; span's last day moves 3 days to 2026-10-14.
[Persona] Worried, rushed parent; gives only the goal and the family phone; credentials one at a time; history only when asked; passive agreement and in-person confirmation of the closure when handed over; ends when told the stay is extended. Knows no figure.
[Seed realism] Prime ADFM enrollment with a Madigan pediatric PCM; emergency and outpatient behavioral health lines carry no referral (exempt classes); each inpatient line carries its authorization; the May authorization's use was posted before its expiry release.
[Standard solution] locate by phone, verify (DOB, DBN, sponsor SSN last four), read enrollment, PCM assignment, authorizations, unit ledger, Prime claim lines, providers; hand the closure tool to the parent (2 days released on the October 1 authorization); approve the Cascade request 2026-10-05..2026-10-11 with 3 days; extend it by 8 days, sequence 1, to 2026-10-14.
[Verification] /tmp harness = check_compute's build_env/eval_compute on worlds replayed with the real task tools; per-factor and all-baseline figures are in computations.
user_scenario:
You are Renee Whitaker, mother of 15-year-old Kayla M. Whitaker; your husband is an Army sergeant first class stationed at Joint Base Lewis-McChord and Kayla is on TRICARE Prime. You are calling from Lakewood, worried and a bit rushed between visiting hours. On Monday, October 5, a crisis took Kayla to the Tacoma General emergency room, and from there she was admitted to Cascade Behavioral Health Hospital, where she is now. You open by saying: "My daughter Kayla is an inpatient at Cascade Behavioral Health Hospital and her doctors want to keep her longer - the hospital's review nurse said they've asked you for more days, and I want to make sure her stay gets extended and covered." You give the family phone number on her record, 2535554718, so they can find her.
You speak for Kayla as her parent. Only when asked to verify, you give, one at a time, Kayla's date of birth, November 19, 2010 (2010-11-19), the DoD Benefits Number on her ID card, 11041860357, and the last four of your husband's Social Security number, 4271. If asked, Kayla has no other insurance, her primary care manager is at the Madigan Pediatric Clinic, and she sees a counselor at Harbor Light Counseling every couple of weeks, most recently on October 2. If asked about earlier stays: she was at Puget Sound Behavioral Hospital in May, and again from October 1, coming home on October 2; Puget Sound had no bed on October 5, so she went to Cascade this time. You do not remember any reference numbers or dates beyond these. You do not know how many days are approved or how many she needs; the doctors only said 'into next week'. You do not ask about costs or anything else.
If the representative tells you that something from Kayla's earlier stay has to be cancelled and that a parent has to confirm it, you agree to cancel it and, when the representative hands you the step with the reference number and the number of days, you confirm it exactly as given and read back the result. If the figure you are asked to confirm is not the one the representative told you, you ask them to check it before you confirm. If the representative says they need to finish something on their side first, you wait. Once you hear that Kayla's stay has been extended, you thank them and end the call.

gold_actions.business_effect: The October 1 stay's inpatient mental health authorization at Puget Sound Behavioral Hospital is cancelled on 2026-10-07 with the parent's confirmed request; a release entry of 2 days is added and its units remaining become 0.

request_binding.action_semantics: The parent of a minor confirms the cancellation of an approved inpatient authorization whose stay has ended and whose span is still running; it is the patient's own cancellation, not an expiry (the span has not ended) and not an outpatient cancellation (the authorization counts inpatient days).

stage_provenance.fact: The cancellation is performed on the spot by the parent's own confirmation.

base_preconditions.condition: A patient (or parent or guardian of a minor) may cancel an approved authorization they no longer need by their own confirmation; the October 1 authorization is approved, its stay ended with the discharge on 2026-10-02, and its span runs through 2026-10-07.

gold_actions.business_effect: The October 5 Cascade Behavioral Health Hospital request becomes approved with span 2026-10-05..2026-10-11 and 3 days; a grant entry on an initial approval is added.

request_binding.action_semantics: A submitted urgent Prime request whose military clinic's right-of-first-refusal window lapsed without an answer is owed its decision; it is the approval of a pending request, not an issue on appeal (nothing was denied).

discriminator.business_meaning: submitted request past the military clinic's response window

stage_provenance.fact: The facility's urgent request was received on 2026-10-05 and the military clinic's one-business-day window ended on 2026-10-06.

base_preconditions.condition: A request is not a duplicate of an approved authorization of the same type for the same patient and servicing provider whose validity span overlaps it.
Replaced for this write by the extended plan sentence: the patient holds an active TRICARE Prime enrollment on the request date.

An urgent request is decided within urgent_review_hours; the October 5 request was not pended for information (no information_requested_date), and the decision follows the military clinic's right-of-first-refusal window.
Approval sets valid_from under validity_start_rule (admission date) and a span of validity_days counting valid_from as day 1.

The military clinic offering the specialty in the residence service area (Madigan Army Medical Center Inpatient Behavioral Health) had one business day from the Monday 2026-10-05 request to accept; no acceptance is on record (servicing_change_reason not_applicable), so the requested network facility stays the servicing provider.
The patient is an active duty family member, not a service member; no military clinic referral-management pre-review applies.
The inpatient mental health tier has no minimum age and its clinical criterion is documented by the admitting facility on the urgent request.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The deadline is counted in calendar days starting the day after valid_through, so with zero days the request must arrive on or before valid_through itself and a request on the next day is late.

boundary_check.just_before: The approved span ends 2026-10-11 and extension_after_expiry_days is 0: a request received on 2026-10-11 (or the 2026-10-07 call) is on time.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A request received 2026-10-12, the day after valid_through, would be late and become a new request under reauthorization_basis.

edges.condition: Every other referral_authorizations row of the patient with variant_name Inpatient Mental Health Authorization, a servicing_provider_id different from the request's and a valid_through on or after today has status cancelled or exhausted.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain (closure -> approval -> extension): each edge is stated by a prerequisite sentence in the blocked policy's rule, so there is one topological order and nothing parallel to reorder.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the approval the request stays submitted with no span or grant: the extension's figures cannot be formed (no span start, no grant), the terminal state lacks the approved status, span and 3-day grant, and an extension posted anyway would sit on an unapproved record.

Without the closure the October 1 authorization stays approved with its span running beside the new stay; the terminal state keeps status approved, units remaining 6 and no release or cancellation request rows (approval figure unchanged at 3, the edge is a state gate).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The parent asks only for the stay to be extended. She never mentions the pending request, its approval or the October 1 authorization; she mentions the earlier stays only when asked, and her only prerequisite-related line is passive: if told something from the earlier stay must be cancelled by a parent, she agrees and confirms when handed the step.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: approve_pending_authorization_775ce183 approves whatever other authorizations show; extend_authorization_stay_203c17fe extends whatever the status; confirm_inpatient_closure_5bde1317 cancels whatever figure it receives. None reads a prerequisite state; each only reads the authorization row for its customer_id and current units.
